## How to use this sheet

For every presenter, write one brief note that shows what you learned, noticed, connected with, questioned, or wanted to comment on. Then rate your own attention honestly:

- **A** = Attentive
- **S** = Some lapses
- **N** = Not attentive

Phones should be away unless directed otherwise. Face the speaker, avoid side conversations, and make space for the person presenting. An honest **S** or **N** is better than a false **A**. Knowingly inaccurate self-ratings can reduce the **Integrity & Reflection** score more than the original lapse would have.

After the final presentation, complete the reflection page. You will evaluate your listening, your Learning Skills, and your own **Past, Present & Becoming** presentation using what you learned from hearing other people.

# Reflection & Submission

Use evidence from what you actually did. If something was not strong, say what happened and what you will do differently next time.

## Listening self-evaluation

| Listening area | What I should evaluate | My score | My evidence or next step |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| Attention & Presence | Phone away, face the speaker, avoid side conversations, refocus after distractions | ___ /2 |  |
| Audience Notes | A specific listening note for each presenter | ___ /2 |  |
| Discussion & Connections | Questions, comments, or connections that help the conversation | ___ /2 |  |

## Learning Skills self-evaluation

For each skill, choose **C = Consistently**, **S = Sometimes**, or **N = Not yet**. In the last column, give evidence of what you did. If you did not show the skill consistently, write what you should do differently next time.

| Learning Skill | C / S / N | What it can look like | My evidence or next step |
|---|:---:|---|---|
| Responsibility | C / S / N | Prepared, phone away, completed and submitted the work |  |
| Organization | C / S / N | Notes complete, readable, and in order |  |
| Independent Work | C / S / N | Worked without repeated reminders |  |
| Collaboration | C / S / N | Was a respectful audience member and supported speakers |  |
| Initiative | C / S / N | Offered a thoughtful question, comment, or connection |  |
| Self-Regulation | C / S / N | Managed distractions and refocused after a lapse |  |

## Google Classroom submission - one PDF

Submit **one PDF** containing all of your completed listening and reflection pages.

- **Digital option:** complete this editable Word file in Word, or upload it to Google Drive and open it with Google Docs. When finished, download/export it as a PDF.
- **Paper option:** scan the completed pages directly to PDF using a document scanning app. If you take regular photos instead, put the clear photos into a Google Doc or Word file in the correct order, then export that file as a PDF.
- Open the final PDF before submitting. Check that every page is readable, upright, complete, and in the correct order.
- Submit the **one PDF**, not separate JPG/PNG images or an editable Word/Google file.
